extras.textures: PBR 4096px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: DDR5 DIMM memory module, 133 x 31 mm PCB (with heat spreader approx. 133 x 39 x 6 mm)
extras.notes: lies flat, light bar faces -Y, contact edge faces +Y; green PCB with 144 gold contacts per side, key notch and latch notches, trace fanout and SMD capacitors; lavender heat spreader on both sides with a raised brushed aluminium wing; emissive RGB light bar on top (pink, lilac, cyan); no text, no logos, no moving parts

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
